name: attribution
definition: Who is explicitly responsible for a passage, statement, note, citation, or editorial act.

name: attachment
definition: Which documentary unit a note/addendum/pointer explicitly targets or is attached to.

name: temporal_succession
definition: Relative documentary/edition order explicitly established by dated/versioned witnesses.

name: citation_derivation
definition: Which named source/scholar/document a passage explicitly cites, quotes, transmits, or derives from.

name: referent_binding
definition: Which person/place/object/proposition a native pointer or explicit identity statement designates.

name: witness_difference
definition: Whether two textual witnesses/editions explicitly contain different readings or reported propositions.

name: editorial_layer
definition: Which historical/editorial layer a span belongs to.

name: modality_marker
definition: Source-explicit uncertainty, possibility, conjecture, or strength marker.

name: digital_assembly
definition: Which historically distinct components are assembled into a digital object.

name: explicit_pointer
definition: A source-native page, line, note, hyperlink, or stand-off pointer between documentary loci.
